calc_items.title: Body surface area
calc_items.question: A child weighs 20 kg and is 110 cm tall. Calculate the body surface area by the Mosteller formula √(height × weight / 3600).

calc_items.title: Absolute neutrophil count
calc_items.question: WBC 1,000/µL with neutrophils 12% and bands 3%. Calculate the absolute neutrophil count.

calc_items.title: Corrected calcium
calc_items.question: Measured calcium 7.2 mg/dL, albumin 2.0 g/dL. Using the conventional Ca + 0.8 × (4 − albumin), calculate the corrected calcium.
calc_items.working: 7.2 + 0.8 × (4 − 2) = 8.8 mg/dL; the correction is unreliable in critical illness and ionised calcium is preferred.

calc_items.title: Maintenance fluid
calc_items.question: Calculate the 24-hour Holliday–Segar maintenance fluid for a 22-kg child (not a tumour-lysis hyperhydration order).

calc_items.title: Tumour volume
calc_items.question: A mass measures 6 × 4 × 3 cm. Estimate its ellipsoid volume = π/6 × length × width × height.
